checkpoints.what: Asserted FIX130 on all six assigned families. Five granted. vt_seal_dui-set refused, exit 8, GRANTED_ELSEWHERE to FIX04 and LIVE -- BLOCKED_BEFORE_CLAIM, no artifact of it read or written. The ledger separately grants vt_seal_misdemeanor-set to FIX130, which the assignment does not name.

Every unaccounted stroke-only stream compared against the source stream it most nearly is, and both pinned sources rendered. Three distinct causes found across the five families, with three different remedies. The SYNTHESIZED_INK_CONFIRMED label is sound as a byte comparison and wrong about cause on 24 of the 40 streams.

All three Vermont hosts proved not to write product-wiring.json. A rebuild at base produced byte-identical fixtures and an empty git status. All six governance keys were already absent on all five families, so nothing was carried forward and nothing lost. npm run rcap:verify-governance-preservation run before every commit.

preserveUnwrittenSelectionBackgrounds gated by family on the shared host, plus the host's hardcoded nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes constant replaced by a measurement. Six stroke-only streams now byte-identical to the pinned source. 600 dpi directional difference: 0 removed on all six pages, 0 added and 0 removed at each of the six check boxes, and page 4 as a negative control gained and lost nothing.

Same gated opt-in on the shared host. Six stroke-only streams now byte-identical to the pinned source in both fixtures. 600 dpi directional difference: 0 removed on all six pages, 0 added and 0 removed at each of the six check boxes, negative-control page 4 gained and lost nothing. One build of this family failed first at 'raster carries no paper-white region' with 81 MB free on the volume; it is an environment condition, not a defect in the family, and the rebuild after disk was reclaimed succeeded and is what is committed.

Third and last family on the shared host that this lane holds and that the assignment names. Same gated opt-in, same acceptance: six stroke-only streams byte-identical to the pinned source in both fixtures, 0 removed on all six pages at 600 dpi, 0 added and 0 removed at each of the six check boxes, negative-control page 4 unchanged in both directions.

Its own host, one line. Packet pages 5 and 6 are now pixel-identical to the Judiciary's own 600-00228 at 600 dpi, which is what a family that writes nothing on that form should deliver. Three negative controls on this family, all 0/0. Also measured: the committed Chromium raster PNGs are not reproducible -- pages whose PDF content did not move by a single pixel had their page.png rewritten by up to 129971 dark pixels, so a raster-PNG diff is not a safe change detector.

The largest of the five and the only one carrying three distinct defect classes with three opposite remedies: 16 invented borders removed, 6 source appearances restored, one 25%-oversized stamp fitted to its rect. It is also the only one of the five whose delivered bytes had REMOVED ink the court prints -- 1407 dark pixels of the check box at 600-00228 field 15, erased and replaced by a displaced 17pt box. That ink is restored and REMOVED is now 0 on every page.

checkpoints.at: identityRefresh erasure found and closed on vt_exp_decriminalized-set
checkpoints.what: The decriminalized rebuild deleted a hand-written identityRefresh annotation from source-receipt.json, and the committed tripwire named this receipt as the only one erased across 301 in the fleet. The host now writes its JSON through preserveIdentityRefresh so no future rebuild drops one. The old block was NOT simply restored, because the record had moved again and the helper correctly drops in that case: the anchor comparison was re-done across the full span 6aafbf81 -> b62ae691 and found identical, with every key the 2026-09-09 lane wrote kept. Tripwire back to EVERY_IDENTITY_REFRESH_SURVIVED, exit 0.

grantsNothing: Checkpoints record work. They promote nothing and approve no packet.
closingNote: Five of the six assigned families are COMPLETED. vt_seal_dui-set was refused at the claim gate and none of its artifacts was read. The claim ledger separately grants vt_seal_misdemeanor-set to FIX130; it is not named in the assignment, it was not built, and it carries the identical 600-00228 defect as vt_seal_dui-set does.
